notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Herd Baloth.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Ravenous Baloth by sacrificing the Beast.
When the Beast dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Ravenous Baloth ability, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3.
